# Groq Free as a distinct replacement route (26 September 2026)

**Disposition: conditional, not qualified.** This is an external service option for M11-OPS-02c, not evidence about Google's Co-Scientist. No Groq inference, runtime adapter, default switch, or production deployment has occurred.

The owner's existing Groq organization visibly has the **Free ($0)** plan. Its **Inference APIs ZDR** control was disabled and was enabled on 26 September; a subsequent readback showed it enabled. Global ZDR and the Batch/Fine-tuning controls were left unchanged. The campaign has no usable Groq credential yet: two newly created, unused 30-day keys were revoked after their secure handoff failed; the local copy of the second revoked key was removed. Existing unrelated keys were untouched. The owner was asked to complete the provider's credential handoff directly. Do not put a key or account identifier in this repository.

Official documentation for `openai/gpt-oss-120b` lists a 131,072-token context, 65,536-token maximum completion, structured output, tool calling, streaming, and a Free-plan allowance of 30 requests/minute, 1,000 requests/day, 8,000 tokens/minute, and 200,000 tokens/day. [Models](https://console.groq.com/docs/models), [rate limits](https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits), [structured outputs](https://console.groq.com/docs/structured-outputs). Structured output cannot share one request with tool calling or streaming; the present app uses those shapes in separate calls. Groq says inference data is normally not retained and that enabling Inference APIs ZDR opts out of its otherwise possible reliability/abuse logging. [Data controls](https://console.groq.com/docs/your-data). The current Free plan is a billing property of this account, not a per-request zero-price cap. A later account upgrade would invalidate the campaign's zero-spend admission, so any use needs a fresh plan/ZDR readback and must stop on 429 rather than falling through to a paid path.

The maintained application currently rejects non-OpenRouter routes in `engine/src/co_scientist/llm_free_policy.py` and the evaluation runner requires `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` in `evaluations/_live_config.py`. `app/app/config.py` does not yet recognize `GROQ_API_KEY` for provider availability. Thus a Groq key alone does not qualify the route. A minimal test-first adapter would preserve OpenRouter and BYOK behavior, pin the exact Groq model and API base, prohibit fallback or paid plugins, and cap the number and size of actual requests. A bounded actual-interface screen, then the frozen public scientific-quality gates, must pass before any default or deployment change. The Free quotas are not proven sufficient for the smallest complete research run; the Express 1,200-call setting is a runaway backstop, not an observed call count. No full-run suitability claim follows from the provider's model list.
